description: Defines the interface and related components for URLRequestContextGetter, which manages retrieval and lifecycle of URLRequestContext objects in network operations.

classes.name: URLRequestContextGetter
classes.description: Interface for retrieving URLRequestContext, with reference counting and lifecycle management.

methods.name: GetURLRequestContext
methods.description: Returns the associated URLRequestContext; must be called on network thread.

methods.name: GetNetworkTaskRunner
methods.description: Returns the task runner for network IO thread.

methods.name: NotifyContextShuttingDown
methods.description: Signals that the URLRequestContext is about to shut down, prompting observers to abort requests.

methods.name: AddObserver
methods.description: Adds an observer for shutdown events; only callable on network thread.

methods.name: RemoveObserver
methods.description: Removes an observer; only callable on network thread.

methods.name: OnDestruct
methods.description: Ensures deletion on the thread where the request IO happens.
